Name: BitStream
Overview: Feel the beat as you weave your way through the pounding techno race tracks of the Bitstream universe. With 4 tournaments spread over 16 challenging courses, it'll take all your skill to defeat your rival racers and claim the title of ultimate Bitstream champion!Bitstream takes classic vector line racing gameplay and gives it a unique audio-sensory makeover. Each movement by both the player and the AI racers is accompanied by beat matched audio cues, which build into a constantly evolving, dynamic sound-scape that ebbs and flows as the race progresses.The full version of Bitstream includes:- 16 unique tracks- 4 challenging tournaments- Freestyle music generator mode- Gamecenter leaderboards and achievements
